parole.testo: From Ottoman Turkish بیلهمك (bilemek, “to sharpen”), ultimately derived from Middle Chinese 劈 (phek, “to slit, to cleave”).
Inherited from Ottoman Turkish صندی (sındı, “shears”), from Early Old Oghuz سِنْدُو (/⁠sïndu⁠/, “shears”), from Middle Chinese 剪刀 (tsjen^X taw, “scissors”). Cognate with Turkmen syndy.
